subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: What permanent exhaustion contract and configuration scope should the agent iteration budget use before the linked implementation PR is accepted?
rationale: The request adds compatibility-sensitive config and requires a product choice among termination, forced final response, last-result delivery, and model-visible warning semantics; source inspection could not resolve maintainer intent.

options.title: Hard budget with terminal outcome
options.body: Add defaults and per-agent limits, reject the next excess tool call, normalize the run as iteration-limit exhaustion, and deliver a deterministic user-facing final message.

options.title: Detection-only guard
options.body: Keep pattern-based loop detection and timeouts as the supported safeguards without adding absolute counters.

options.title: Broader guardrails framework
options.body: Defer this request into a larger rate, cost, action-cap, and policy framework rather than adding focused iteration limits now.

recommendation.title: Hard budget with terminal outcome
recommendation.body: Add defaults and per-agent limits, reject the next excess tool call, normalize the run as iteration-limit exhaustion, and deliver a deterministic user-facing final message.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied discussion shows direct prior review and routing involvement on the exact product contract.
